name: outfit
description: Use local connectors, skills, and pasted-link context through outfit.

interface.longDescription: Use locally configured connectors through concise typed CLI commands generated from one Connector Kit contract, with a compact read-only MCP fallback for discovery and dispatch. Manage pinned provider CLIs and credentials, load only enabled connector skills and workflows, fetch supported pasted links, and restore portable encrypted configuration without a hosted control plane.
defaultPrompt: Find the right typed outfit CLI command for this task.
